verdict.rationale: The personalization docs describe personal instructions that persist; in Codex they are stored in a global AGENTS.md file, which Codex reads before doing any work, so they shape every task. Memories also carry context from earlier chats into future work, and /memories controls whether a chat uses or contributes to them. missing for 10: an explicit description of the ChatGPT-side custom-instructions/preferences settings (the excerpt only implies them), detail on response-style preferences or tone controls, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the instructions consistently shape responses.
